description: This file defines the IoTEventsClient class used for interacting with AWS IoT Events service via the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various AWS IoT Events operations, both synchronous and asynchronous.

classes.name: IoTEventsClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS IoT Events service, extending the AWS SDK's base client class.

methods.name: createAlarmModel
methods.description: Creates a new alarm model in AWS IoT Events.

methods.name: createAlarmModelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new alarm model in AWS IoT Events.

methods.name: deleteAlarmModelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an existing alarm model.

methods.name: describeAlarmModel
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific alarm model.

methods.name: describeAlarmModelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a specific alarm model.
